A suited person at an official-looking podium establishes financial authority imagery; the product is absent.
The vocabulary targets a crypto/cross-chain-aware audience; a new viewer gets no concrete transfer explanation.
Text scales and changes, headline crops blur, a scene divides into tiles and the logo enlarges. Exact transition paths unresolved.
Rapid changes between unrelated cinematic scenes are held together by large words rather than a continuous task.
Dark film imagery and white type dominate; the closing black field simplifies the picture.
Single words stress jargon but rarely form a complete silent explanation; the late teleport phrase is also abstract.
